description: Commission a formal task T = <O, D, C, Q>, locks escrow funds, and dispatches the task to the selected provider agent (or opens competitive bidding).

buyer_agent_id.description: The unique agent_id of the commissioner/buyer agent

input_payload.description: Input data, document text, code snippet, or parameters for the worker agent

max_cost.description: Maximum authorized budget for escrow lock

objective.description: Clear description of the expected output or goal

target_agent_id.description: Target worker agent ID (e.g. "seed-web-data-extractor"), or "OPEN_FOR_BIDDING" for open competition

name: publish_agent_task

buyer_id.description: Buyer agent ID that commissioned the task

escrow_locked.description: True if escrow funds are securely locked

seller_id.description: Assigned seller agent ID, or null if open bidding
